segment.source: Renders every capability as a dense multi-column index of linked one-liners, in the order an editor gives them — the reference list rather than the sales band. Use it for: 'all features' pages, module catalogues, comparison footers, sitemap-like overviews, the page a search engine should find every term on. Prefer 'Feature Grid' when a dozen entries need selling rather than listing, and 'Included Checklist' when readers care whether each line is part of their plan.
